# Udyog Growth
Udyog Growth is India's premier business compliance, regulatory, and school admission consultancy, serving Delhi-NCR and Bihar with ethical, process-driven expertise.

## Core Services
- GST Defence & Litigation
- Government Subsidies (PMFME, PMEGP, MSME)
- Regulatory Clearances (DPCC, UPPCB, HSPCB, FSSAI)
- Delhi NCR School Admissions (DPS, Modern School, British School, etc.)
